_what: The USB Type-C termination values pcb.usbc_receptacle holds a receptacle's CC resistors to, each quoted from its table. A value here is the specification's band for the termination itself: the resistor's own tolerance (the record's cc_resistor_tol_pct) must keep it inside.
specification: Universal Serial Bus Type-C Cable and Connector Specification, Release 2.0, August 2019 (USB 3.0 Promoter Group, published by USB-IF)
_releases: Release 2.0 was read: it is the newest release usb.org serves as a plain PDF. Later releases (2.3 and on) ship as zip archives and were not read here; re-read Tables 4-24 and 4-25 there before changing a value.
